title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video: open tools for video and avatar generation
friendlyTitle: LongCat-Video offers open AI video and avatar tools
summary: LongCat-Video provides Python code for text-to-video, image-to-video and audio-driven avatar generation, including single- and multi-speaker avatar workflows. The repository has about 8,200 stars and returned to today’s AI-related Python trends.
friendlySummary: This Python project can create video from text or images and animate avatars from audio. It is designed for people who can run AI models themselves.
whyItMatters: Researchers and capable creators can inspect or run a full video-generation pipeline rather than relying only on a hosted interface. Local use requires substantial compute, and generated people or voices should be labelled and used with consent.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can study and test video generation on their own systems. It needs strong hardware, and you should get permission before copying a person’s face or voice.
